searchText: Hey does anyone happen to have the Witti genesis state floating around? *genesis state root (don't need the whole state) Looking at https://github.com/goerli/witti, it seems the boot ENR decodes to this: ``` ENR Read Sequence No: 2 Node ID: 0x5b8c..0cf7 IP: 0.0.0.0 TCP Port: 30000 UDP Port: 30000 ``` there are no bootnodes up yet I'm waiting for a genesis from lighthouse 😜 The “faster-genesis” branch will generate one but I’m not sure it’s the same as anyone else’s haha What's your genesis root? And time? I’ve stepped away from the computer, I don’t have it on me at the moment Ah damn, I should move further east 😄 I’ll grab it, one sec ``` May 25 18:35:08.036 INFO Genesis ceremony complete genesis_time: 1590174000, genesis_validators: 6, service: beacon ``` ``` curl "localhost:5052/beacon/state_root?slot=0" "0xd41cc44a345826d44c3efc18bfaf661f2a840e4c37489946dcd1a1ad4deee6d5" ``` The time is correct Can't recall the state root I forgot to push the genesis root to github 🤦 I'll reset the testnet with the faster-genesis branch, this looks promising Cool! I'll holding off on merging that branch until I can see someone agrees with me. <@!361447803194441738> This it what my witti prysm beacon says. So your state root matches with that. Thanks <@219523277163331586>, much appreciated! New Genesis Time: May 26, 2020, 9am UTC I pushed a new config Unfortunately, I cannot supply bootnodes prior to genesis But maybe you want to just test genesis locally hm, but the warning on the witti repo disappeared, how to understand that from my understanding sending deposits to the contract from the new config (containing its genesis) only bring "results" after genesis "point-in-time" (=block#xyz) has happened so after tomorrow after 9 am UTC the contract takes effekt and validators can be "registered" ? yes, better wait till tomorrow but I managed to set up bootnodes already very nice to hear, i am also ready and prepared, i hope that it works <@!557201004060213248> make sure you are on the correct branch I updated the docs today > New Genesis Time: May 26, 2020, 9am UTC plus 1 day min genesis delay so it's more like 5pm UTC ``` May 25 18:55:20.758 INFO Genesis ceremony complete genesis_time: 1590537600, genesis_validators: 6, service: beacon May 25 18:55:20.770 INFO Beacon chain initialized head_slot: 0, head_block: 0x19aa…ba12, head_state: 0x773c…5b17, service: beacon ``` Lighthouse confirms 5pm UTC tomorrow <@!557201004060213248> Awesome. How do you want to transition from schlesi? Shall I stop my schlesi nodes, and start new ones for witti? My Schlesi bootnodes still have 13 peers. I'll leave them running another week but potentially shut them down soon Teku agrees with Lighthouse <@!361447803194441738> - so you can merge #1103 ``` 19:11:46.281 INFO - Genesis Event *** Initial state root: 0x773c694b47504d789dc768d2356f691866b47833d0d85e02511d7cd339925b17, Genesis block root: 0x19aa2deaa02cac9774eb8948a8ead1ebe851ba9590878a10cd5767092e16ba12 ``` <@!557201004060213248> which is the correct branch--reading the docs myself git checkout faster-genesisgit checkout faster-genesis well, looks fine atm done- and prepared and showing correct values during start Has anyone already connected to the bootnodes with prysm? It doesn't look like I'm connecting... genesis is in 22 hours but, if genesis time is 1590537600 isn t that 05/27/2020 @ 12:00am ? that timestamp comes from the snippet posted by <@557201004060213248> above activated <https://eth2stats.io/witti-testnet> , will update genesis time tomorrow if wrong that's 12 am indeed why is it so late that's 2am in europe xD My favourite thing about the mainnet spec is it always kicks off at midnight UTC. I think it's the only event ever in Ethereum to happen at a convenient time. Eth2 truly is the dawn of Australian Ethereum dominance. 😛 > Unfortunately, I cannot supply bootnodes prior to genesis <@!557201004060213248> It is possible to distrubute bootnodes prior to genesis, if you wish.
